assets.caption: The scene is a functional industrial complex situated at the edge of a lush, green forest, presented in a realistic style with a practical and somewhat austere tone. A large, rectangular concrete building dominates the foreground, featuring a row of four tall, dark gray metal doors, each equipped with prominent handles and a yellow warning sign depicting a lightning bolt. Each door has a dark gray rectangular awning directly above it, providing minimal shelter. A circular no-parking sign with a red border and diagonal line is affixed to the concrete wall between the first and second doors from the left. The building's roof is flat and appears to be covered with green foliage, blending into the natural environment behind it. To the right of the building, an asphalt road curves away, with a thin yellow line marking its edge and a white pole visible further down the road, possibly indicating a roadside marker or utility pole. The road is bordered by a well-maintained grassy area that transitions into a dense forest of various deciduous trees with dark green and olive foliage, suggesting a mature woodland. The sky above is overcast with soft, diffused light, indicating a cloudy day. The concrete building extends horizontally across the foreground, with the doors evenly spaced. The road begins near the right side of the building and curves to the right and into the distance, with the forest filling the background behind the road and the building. The 360 scene is faultless.
